chunks: Muḥammad ibn Khālid narrated from Saʿd ibn Saʿd al-Ashʿarī, from Abī al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام, who said:
I asked him about zakat al-fiṭrah: how much is to be paid for each person from wheat, barley, dates, and raisins?
He said: “One ṣāʿ, according to the ṣāʿ of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله.”

key_terms.التَّمْرِ: dates as one of the valid staple foods mentioned
key_terms.الزَّبِيبِ: raisins as one of the valid staple foods mentioned
key_terms.الشَّعِيرِ: barley as one of the valid staple foods mentioned
key_terms.الْحِنْطَةِ: wheat as one of the valid staple foods mentioned
key_terms.الْفِطْرَةِ: zakat al-fiṭrah, the alms due at the end of Ramadan
key_terms.بِصَاعِ النَّبِيِّ: according to the standard measure of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.صَاعٌ: a prophetic measure used to determine the required amount
key_terms.كُلِّ رَأْسٍ: each individual person for whom fiṭrah is paid

ai.seo_question: How much zakat al-fiṭrah must be given per person according to Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling on the amount of zakat al-fiṭrah due per person. Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام states that it is one ṣāʿ of staple food, measured according to the ṣāʿ of the Prophet صلى الله عليه وآله.
